subject: Founder support package — structure, splitting credits, and invoicing
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@seeddock.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Price <olivia@seeddock.co>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Founder support package for SeedDock cohort

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We loved Redwood's latency and the cost controls; a few founders asked whether we can layer your promo credits with a short-term reserved capacity commitment for demo day traffic.

Can you confirm:
- Whether free cohort credits (promo pool) can be converted / split across multiple internal teams on our side?
- If a startup converts to Dedicated within 60–90 days, can those promo credits be applied as a one-time invoice credit or do they only offset hosted usage?
- Any tax/accounting treatment we should expect if we ask for a single invoice that splits the reserved commit and promotional discount?

We're working with Finance to finalize the pilot budget and want the accounting flow documented so we can present it to our CFO. If possible can you send an options summary and a one-pager we can hand to them?

Appreciate it — we want to move quickly if the economics work.

Best,
Maya
Program Lead, SeedDock

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@seeddock.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Founder support package for SeedDock cohort

Maya — thanks for the clear list. High level answers up front, details below and attached: I took a pass at three packaging options and attached an options workbook plus a draft mutual action plan (MAP).

Short answers:
- Promo credits are normally tied to the SeedDock account and redeemable against hosted usage. We can allow credits to be split across up to three internal teams under the same SeedDock billing account with a manual allocation at issuance.
- If a startup converts to Dedicated within 90 days, we can offer a conversion credit that offsets their first invoice. That requires a one-time contract addendum.
- For invoicing we can provide a separate invoice line for the reserved-commit charge and a separate credit line for the promo value. Our finance team treats the promo as a discount.

Attachments: support-package-options.xlsx (three packaging scenarios), MAP-draft.pdf (timeline + milestones).

Next steps I propose:
1) We share the options with your Finance and Operations team.
2) Pick an option and we draft a short addendum for the conversion-credit path.
3) Set a 30-minute call to align billing info and invoicing contacts.

Looping Marissa and Laura for the final wording and any tax nuance. Happy to hop on a call tomorrow afternoon.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya@seeddock.co>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Founder support package for SeedDock cohort

Adding detail on ops/finance constraints so the team has a clean description for SeedDock's CFO:

Operational notes:
- Allocation: We can pre-allocate promo vouchers to specific startup email addresses (up to three buckets) at issuance. That gives the cohort leads control without issuing separate billing accounts.
- Conversion credit: We offer a one-time conversion credit equal to up to 50% of remaining promo value (capped at $5k) if the customer signs a Dedicated commitment within 90 days. This is a one-off exception for accelerator programs — requires legal approval and signature on an addendum.

Accounting notes:
- Promo credits are recorded as contra-revenue (discounts) on a separate invoice line. We will produce an invoice that shows Gross Reserved Charge, Promotional Discount (negative line), and Net Due.
- For tax: because it's a promotional discount and not a cash rebate, SeedDock's startups should treat the discount as a reduction in expense; they'll want to confirm with their local tax advisor.

Attachment: promo-accounting-guidance.docx (short note finance teams can use).

Ben — if we proceed, I can draft the addendum language and the invoice examples. Laura — any comments on the cap or timeframe?

-marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <maya@seeddock.co>

Cc: Olivia Price <olivia@seeddock.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 15:34:00 -07:00

Thanks Ben / Marissa — this is exactly what Finance needed. Quick clarifications before we present:

1) Can credits be split across teams but redeemed by individual startup billing profiles (we want founders to keep usage visibility)?
2) The conversion-credit formula: is it "up to 50% of remaining promo value, capped at $5k" per startup or per cohort? Would like to confirm it's per startup.
3) For the invoice: can you produce a sample invoice PDF showing the separate credit line and net due? We prefer to send that to our CFO rather than a spreadsheet.

If you can send a one-page summary + sample invoice, we'll route to CFO and aim to confirm the cohort packaging by next Wednesday. Also happy to take the 30-minute call — 9–11am PT preferred.

Best,
Maya
